No new idle utility bezel, header displacement or header-content clipping is visible. Retained facts report identical header frames within each before/busy/after sequence: default (12,51,351,114.33333333333331), AX5 (12,51,351,281.3333333333333).

Default captures include stars before/busy/after. AX5 before and busy show no visible board stars; after shows stars entering the foreground scroll crop, including partial bodies at its upper boundary. The early harness captures do not establish settled initial scroll/scene visibility. This is neither a whole-board pass nor evidence of a current product regression. Stable-header proof remains separate.
